messages:
alina: opened PR to add Turquoise-7B model card + small fixes to the catalog (limits + bench pointers). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4381

tom: thanks. can we call out that Turquoise uses mixed BPE and may pad differently? that caused a token-count mismatch in one of our evals.

alina: good catch. will add a "tokenizer behavior" bullet and link to the eval notebook.

jess: SDK snippets nit: node snippet uses `model_id` but python shows `model`. can we standardize in the card examples?

alina: suggestion: use `model` in python + curl, and show node with `model_id` and a short footnote explaining param names differ by SDK.

tom: also add a small limits row: max_context 4096, recommended_batch: 8, streaming: supported (low-latency mode).

alina: added limits and the tokenizer note. fixed a broken anchor to the compatibility matrix that was 404ing.

infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled 2026-09-12T08:00Z for docs/catalog changes only.

jess: LGTM. left one inline about curl header order (Auth then Content-Type).

alina: merged: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4381/merge. will follow up with an expanded 4k token bench and a small notebook showing padding impact.
